title: [ingest] sphinx.ext.apidoc is now a loadable Sphinx extension (not just a CLI tool)
summary: Since #13333 was merged, `sphinx.ext.apidoc` has a `setup()` function that connects `run_apidoc` to the `builder-inited` event. Adding it to `extensions` in `conf.py` replaces the old pre-build `sphinx-apidoc` CLI invocation. The extension reads apidoc config from `conf.py` rather than CLI flags.
